name: Geartown

name: Kotodama

name: Gokipon

name: Herald of Orange Light

name: Blackwing - Sirocco the Dawn
extDescription: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon or Set this card without Tributes. Monsters other than that target cannot attack during the turn you activate this effect.
